turns.text: It makes your no feel much softer.
turns.zh: 这样你的拒绝听起来会柔和很多。

turns.text: And then you can give your reason.
turns.zh: 然后你就可以给出你的理由。

turns.text: Tom said, "I have a dentist appointment." You don't have to give a long explanation.
turns.zh: 汤姆说：「我约了牙医。」你不用解释一大堆。

turns.text: A short, honest reason is best.
What are some other ways to say no politely?
turns.zh: 还有哪些礼貌拒绝的说法？

turns.text: Well, another good one could be, "Unfortunately, I'm not able to."
turns.zh: 嗯，另一个不错的说法可以是：「很遗憾，我没办法。」
